title: feat(spec)!: defineStack holds a module package to at most one app, as it does an app package
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuXKFtP8XRKJg7Yjicr3JmTL)_

Fixes #32586

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: follow-up #32809

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** `defineStack` 现在也拒绝定义了两个以上应用的模块包（`type: 'module'`），和应用包（`type: 'app'`）一样；报错写出包 id、找到的每个应用和改法（每个包一个应用，多出的应用各自放进一个模块包）。
- **为什么改：** ADR-0019 D3 修订后允许一个套件展示多个应用，前提是每个包至多一个；这条规则此前只对应用包执行，模块包放两个应用照样能构建，然后在控制台按包 id 寻址、按包 id 读取、停用模块这三处出错。
- **风险与回滚：** 这是收窄：以前能构建的「一个模块包两个应用」现在被拒。实测本仓与 hotcrm 没有任何包这样写（cloud 仓无读权限，未测）；回滚就是 revert 本 PR。
- **先看：** `packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts` 的 `validateSingleApp` 与 `SINGLE_APP_PACKAGE_TYPES`；`packages/spec/src/stack-duplicate-entry.test.ts` 里 apps 对照行的改写；`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.module-package-second-app-refused.ts`。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/stack.test.ts -t "at most one App per package"`，预期 7 条全绿，其中一条是「模块包两个应用被拒并点名包和两个应用」。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `validateSingleApp` (`packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts`) judges every package type in the new `SINGLE_APP_PACKAGE_TYPES` (`app` and `module`, the two a suite is made of under ADR-0019 (app-as-consumer-unit) D3 as amended), where it used to return early for anything but `app`. A `type: 'module'` package with two or more apps is refused with the existing `STACK_SINGLE_APP_VIOLATION` (422), same envelope, same header.
- The finding now names the package id, every app found (quoted) and the remedy, and cites the amended D3: "A 'module' package must define at most one app, but package 'com.example.p.service' defines 2 ('app_one', 'app_two'). Keep one app per package: move each other app into a 'module' package of its own — ADR-0019 (app-as-consumer-unit) D3 as amended (a suite may surface several apps, one per package)." The app package's finding is the same sentence opening "An 'app' package", plus ", or fold them into one app with multiple tabs". Both keep the words "must define at most one app", which `packages/cli/test/generate-scaffolds-reach-stack.e2e.test.ts` matches.
- Behaviour kept: an app package with two apps is refused as before; zero or one app passes for both types; every other package type (`plugin`, `driver`, ...) is not judged; a stack with no manifest is not judged; `strict: false` skips it as before.
- ADR-0087: a new semantic entry, `module-package-second-app-refused` (the changeset says `registered`). `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` can no longer ride `no-migration-prescription`.
- Ledger and evidence text: the `STACK_SINGLE_APP_VIOLATION` row comment in `error-code-ledger.zod.ts`, the error class docblock, and the `manifest.type` evidence in `packages/spec/liveness/manifest.json`, which quoted the old early return and called the rule "consumer packages only". The anchor (`stack.zod.ts#validateSingleApp`) is unchanged; the quote and gloss are rewritten, `verifiedAt` moves to 2026-11-12.
- Changeset `.changeset/32586-module-package-single-app.md`: `@objectstack/spec` minor, BREAKING banner, FROM/TO fix.

## Why

The amended D3 (#32585, merged as `958734cbac`) lets a suite surface several apps only because each one is housed in its own package. Its three reasons are the Console's package-id routing, an app's own-package objects, and module disable removing the module's app. `validateSingleApp` returned `[]` for any `manifest.type !== 'app'` (origin/main `88282a78`), so a module package with two apps built clean. Declared means enforced.

## Measured: packages that define more than one app today

Read-only, static: every `defineStack` / `composeStacks` call site, every `*.app.ts`, every `apps:` collection in non-test sources, and every plugin manifest that registers apps.

| Repository (tree) | Package | Type | Apps |
|---|---|---|---|
| objectstack `88282a78` | `examples/app-crm` | app | 1 (`CrmApp`) |
| | `examples/app-todo` | app | 1 (`TodoApp`) |
| | `examples/app-showcase` | app | 1 (`ShowcaseApp`) |
| | `examples/app-multi-package` core / orders | app / module | 1 / 0 |
| | `packages/create-objectstack` blank template, and the `os init` templates | app | 1 (`main`) |
| | `packages/apps/connector-docusign`, `-github`, `-stripe` | app | 0 |
| | `packages/apps/setup`, `studio`, `account` | plugin | 1 each (registered through the plugin manifest, not `defineStack`) |
| | `packages/platform-objects/scripts/i18n-extract.config.ts` | no manifest | 3 (`SETUP_APP`, `STUDIO_APP`, `ACCOUNT_APP`): a build-time synthetic config for `os i18n extract`, not a package; a stack with no manifest is not judged, before or after |
| | `packages/drivers/driver-memory`, `plugin-auth`, `plugin-hono-server`, `plugin-security`, `service-i18n` configs | driver / adapter / plugin | 0 |
| hotcrm `8277e61` | `app.objectstack.hotcrm` (`src/sales`) | app | 1 (`CrmApp`) |
| | `.service` (`src/service`) | module | 1 (`ServiceApp`) |
| | `.marketing` (`src/marketing`) | module | 1 (`MarketingApp`) |
| | `.revenue`, `.o2c` | module | 0 |
| cloud | NOT MEASURED | | this session has no read access to `objectstack-ai/cloud` (`add_repo`: no access) |

Result: no package in either measured repository defines more than one app, at any type. HotCRM is already in its planned shape and keeps building. The only stack with several apps is the manifest-less i18n extract config, which no package type covers.

Test fixtures: one fixture in this package put two distinct apps in a module package on purpose, `stack-duplicate-entry.test.ts`'s `apps` CONTROL rows (array and map form), and its comment said why: "an `app` package's single-app count would refuse two DISTINCT apps, which the control rows need to accept". That is the gap this PR closes, so those two rows now assert that a distinct-name pair passes the duplicate check and meets the single-app count instead (`STACK_SINGLE_APP_VIOLATION`, both names in order). The other 26 control rows are unchanged. Consumer fixtures outside `packages/spec` that pair a module manifest with apps were read one by one; each module body carries zero or one app, or the file judges through `lintConfig` rather than `defineStack`. The consumer test files that name a `type: 'module'` manifest were also run against the built `packages/spec/dist`: `packages/cli` 16 files / 122 tests, `packages/metadata` 2 / 38, `packages/objectql` 4 / 96, `packages/runtime` 2 / 37, all green. Four more files only write a `package.json` with `"type": "module"` (three cli e2e files and `types/node.test.ts`), not a stack manifest.

## Tests

- `packages/spec/src/stack.test.ts`, the existing describe "at most one App per package": the app-package refusal now asserts the envelope (`code`, `status`, one issue, the issue in the message) and names the package and both apps; new: a module package with two apps is refused, naming the package and both apps; a module package with one app and with none passes; the `driver` pin stays ("package types other than app and module"); HotCRM's planned shape (an app package and two modules with one app each, a module with none) builds and composes under `manifest: 'preserve'`, each body carrying its own app.
- `packages/spec/src/stack-duplicate-entry.test.ts`: the `apps` controls as above.
- Ablation, on the committed fix (spec tests read `src/`), through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each leg restored with the blob equal to HEAD (`3474eb88`):
  - A, `new Set(['app', 'module'])` → `new Set(['app'])`: 3 red (the module refusal and both `apps` controls).
  - B, the finding without the package id: 2 red (the app and module naming pins).
  - C, `apps.length <= 1` → `apps.length < 1` (a mutation, to show the preservation pins can fail): 11 red, among them the one-app pins and the suite-shape pin.

## Acceptance notes

- **Branch name.** The platform assigned `claude/project-thread-p4errz` to this card thread, not `claude/issue-32586-*`; the claim (6831348754) names it.
- **Three shapes the check does not judge, reported to the seat, not built here** (seat disposition: 1 and 3 → filed #32810; 2 → dropped — no ruling holds a `plugin` package to one app, and the amended D3 builds a suite from app and module packages only; #32810 names it as a decision-card question if the lane wants it judged) (probed once on this head against the built `packages/spec/dist`, not kept as tests):
  1. A flat `composeStacks` (default `manifest: 'last'`) of an app package and a module package with one app each answers one package, the module's manifest, carrying two apps. Nothing refuses it; `composeStacks` is outside this card.
  2. A `type: 'plugin'` package with two apps passes `defineStack`. The platform's own `setup`, `studio` and `account` packages are `plugin` packages that surface one app each, so a rule for plugins would hold them to one, not forbid them.
  3. `defineStack` handed an artifact whose `packages[]` holds a module body with two apps passes: `validateSingleApp` reads the top-level manifest and `apps` only.
- **Docs that now read narrow, not wrong:** `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md` § App Navigation says `defineStack` refuses a second app "in a `type: 'app'` package" (the `Skills-docs:` follow-up, filed #32809, which also carries the ADR-0019 status line and the ADR-0130 fact row the contract review named; product PRs do not edit `skills/**` or `docs/adr/**`). `content/docs/ui/audience-based-interfaces.mdx` and `docs/design/marketplace-publishing.md` say the same for app packages only; both stay true.
- **Cloud not measured:** accepted by the seat — a cloud package with two apps in one module would now fail loudly at `os validate` / `os build` with `STACK_SINGLE_APP_VIOLATION` and the remedy, not silently; no data path changes.
- **Contract review nits N1–N4** (6833950860): N2 and N3 → #32810; N1 (module finding omits the fold remedy) and N4 (no `relevantWhen`) accepted as deviations.
- **No `content/docs/releases/`, `CHANGELOG.md` or generated reference edits.** `check:generated` regenerated nothing.

## Verification

The branch was merged with `main` (`ee230a25`, clean, generated artifacts unchanged) after the PR opened; the final head is `631b9df5`. Each line says which head it was read on.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: Test Files 836 passed (836), Tests 26734 passed, 1 todo, on `f869d1a2` and again on `631b9df5` (lock VERDICT command-exit 0 both times).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`: exit 0 on `f869d1a2` (includes `check:test-typecheck` OK, 131 pinned signatures held); on `631b9df5` the CI `TypeScript Type Check` lanes are green.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: all 14 generated artifacts up to date, on both heads.
- `node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base origin/main`: exit 0, `registered module-package-second-app-refused (new here)`, on both heads.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs --base origin/main`: exit 0 on both heads; the level axis reads the PR body in CI (`Check Changeset` green).
- `pnpm lint` (eslint over the whole tree, `--no-inline-config`): exit 0, no findings, on `f869d1a2`; on `631b9df5` the CI `Lint · ESLint` lane is green.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 98 families derived (the same list on both heads), all 98 run on `631b9df5` with exit 0, `--ran` reconciliation 0 NOT-MEASURED. On `f869d1a2` two had first answered exit 3 for a missing prerequisite and were re-run green: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` after the missing dists were built (123 require entry points across 72 packages load), and `check:type-check-debt` under the verify lock (128/131 packages type-checked, 0 in the DEBT ledger).
- Dogfood battery (owed: the title carries `!`, `Clause-②:` carries `(narrowing)`), `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the verify lock after the `@objectstack/dogfood^...` closure build (70/70): on `631b9df5`, Test Files 455 passed, 3 skipped (458), Tests 3817 passed, 42 skipped (3859); on `f869d1a2`, 455 / 3816 passed. Lock VERDICT command-exit 0 both times.
- CI on `631b9df5`: all 67 check-runs `success` or `skipped`. Three aggregators on `f869d1a2` read `failure` only because the merge push cancelled their lanes.
- Contract review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` on `631b9df5`: PASS, comment 6833950860 (brief 6833933555). No must-fix or should-fix; four nits, left as accepted deviations or follow-ups.
